crime_description: Assassinating a prominent investigative journalist. Interrogators should probe for connections to an inside police officer, financial motives, remote burner phone coordination, offshore accounts, and private flight plans.

suspect.name: Zane Cruz
suspect.fake_alibi: Zane claims he was visiting his sick mother in the hospital.

secrets.value: A corrupt police officer who lured the journalist to an isolated location.
Zane was hired by a corrupt politician whom the journalist was investigating.
was actively coordinating the crime from a secure burner phone
untraceable offshore account holding the illicit funds
chartered a private flight under a fake identity
